en.headline: Tai Kwun Hong Kong movie exhibition runs into early October
en.dek: Better Together – Partnering Up for Hong Kong Movies is on at the Duplex Studio in Central through 4 October, with replica sets and interviews from film crews.
body: Tai Kwun’s summer exhibition on partnership in Hong Kong cinema remains open at the Duplex Studio in Block 01 through 4 October, the venue said.

Better Together – Partnering Up for Hong Kong Movies, curated by film director Sunny Chan Wing San and presented with the Federation of Hong Kong Filmmakers, uses reconstructed sets and replica props to look at on-screen pairings and the crews behind them. Titles cited by the organisers include The Black Rose (1965), Aces Go Places (1982), Police Story 3: Super Cop, Rob-B-Hood, Blind Detective and the 2024 film Temporary Robbery.

The exhibition is open from 11am to 7pm. Regular tickets are HK$30 and concession tickets HK$20 for full-time students, people aged 60 or above and persons with disabilities; children aged four or under enter free. Tickets are sold on the Tai Kwun website and Klook.
Tai Kwun is at 10 Hollywood Road, Central. The organisers said the show includes interviews with people who worked on the films, among them actors and directors named in the programme notes.

zh.headline: 大館港產片「拍住上」展覽展至10月4日
zh.dek: 大館夏季展覽「拍住上—光影裡並肩馳馳的我們」在中環01座複式展室舉行至10月4日，重現經典對手戲場景及道具複製品。
body: 大館表示，夏季展覽「拍住上—光影裡並肩馳馳的我們」繼續在01座複式展室展出，至10月4日結束。
展覽由電影導演陳詠燊策劃，並與香港電影工作者總會合辦，以重構場景和道具複製品回顧港產片的拍檔關係與幕後團隊。主辦單位提到的片目包括《黑玫瑰》（1965）、《最佳拍檔》（1982），以至《警察故事III超級警察》、《寶貝計劃》、《盲探》及較近期的《臨時劫案》等。
開放時間為上午11時至下午7時。標準票30元，全日制學生、60歲或以上長者及殘疾人士優惠票20元，4歲或以下小童免費。門票於大館網站及Klook發售。
大館位於中環荷李活道10號。主辦單位指展覽亦有電影工作者訪談，節目資料列舉多位參與相關作品的演員及導演。
